author: Demetrius Simms
title: This $75 Million Beachfront Compound Sits Along Barbados's Platinum Coast - NewsBreak
text:
By Demetrius Simms ,
6 hours ago A deep dive into the portfolio of Barbados-based Larry Warren Architects reveals several larger-than-life projects, from One Sandy Lane—where Rihanna bought a condo in 2013—to private estates like Kalinago , a colossal 75,000-square-foot multigenerational waterfront retreat along the island’s coveted west coast.
The Tiny Italian Island Featured in 'The Odyssey' Could Become a Tourist Hotspot
Crowning nearly 1.5 acres in St. Peter, at the northern end of Barbados’s sun-kissed Platinum Coast, the gated compound enjoys direct access to white-sand beaches, warm turquoise waters, and sweeping vistas of the Caribbean Sea. Beyond the gates, the island offers a wealth of diversions, from golf at Apes Hill to trackside seats at the Sandy Lane Gold Cup .
Inside one of the main living areas with floor-to-ceiling sliding doors that open to a terrace. Bajanpro Inc./Kerwin Elias Fashioned from rare, hand-carved Barbadian coral stone and Bufalini Marmi marble, the five-story megamansion blends timeless craftsmanship with modern sophistication. Airy common areas provide ample room for gathering, with a total of 20 bedrooms offering space for extended family and guests.

Four of the floors are configured as spacious private apartments, each with grand living and dining areas and kitchens outfitted with Neff cabinetry and Maison Vervloet hardware. Every residence includes five bedrooms and six bathrooms, with primary suites featuring Africa Mahogany closets and marble-clad en suites; one suite spans two floors. Each apartment opens to a private terrace with alfresco dining and lounging areas, a bar/café, and an ocean-facing infinity pool.
An al fresco dining area sits near one of the ocean-view infinity pools. Bajanpro Inc./Kerwin Elias Shared amenities include a fitness center, yoga studio, theater room, wine cellar, offices, and staff quarters on every level. The estate is rounded out by underground parking for up to 18 vehicles, a rooftop terrace, and an elevator. Kalinago is now available for $75 million with Justin Walcott of Christie’s International Real Estate Barbados.
